name: Green Bank Telescope with the L-band receiver
note: The 21 cm line receiver. Gain in K/Jy and the pointing accuracy are not stated in the sources read, and are absent.

aperture.n: the page: 100 m (effective); a 110 m x 100 m unblocked section of a 208 m parent paraboloid

collectingArea.n: the guide gives the dish area, not a diameter

instruments.name: Rcvr1_2 (L band) with the autocorrelation spectrometer

systemTemperature.n: the page; Boothroyd et al. (2011, Sec. 2) report 18 K at the zenith for the same receiver

beamReferenceFrequency.n: the paper equates 21 cm with 1420 MHz

beamFwhm.n: 9.1 x 9.0 arcmin (cross-elevation x elevation) at 21 cm; the larger is stored

bandwidth.n: the spectrometer configuration used in that paper

velocityResolution.n: in the 21 cm line, for that configuration
